loss.mechanism: add a timing-weight-normalized star-edge attraction term to the maintained pair objective
loss.decision: raise the loss when high-weight graph-connected supernode embeddings are dissimilar, pushing them toward the same unchanged decoder tier
loss.prediction: the target case's mean paired score rises with a less-negative TNS deficit while other case means stay within tolerance
loss.falsifier: target-case mean paired score delta is non-positive, or any case mean falls more than 5 points below the parent.

experiment.question: Can a loss change of S raise bp-ng45 without losing its other designs?

target.rule: mean paired score delta over the case > 0 and most of its seeds improve
